affectedPublicSurfaces: demo.app-juli.com run route — the Đề xuất stage option picker (apps/demo)

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic. This surface authorizes a real mutation, so the candidate journey runs against a replayed decision request only; no production write is in scope
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section: 'reach a replayed decision request, select an option, confirm, and observe the chosen continuation.' Transcribed verbatim; no additional surfaces inferred. apiSideEffectsInScope is true because confirming issues a real confirmation call — the journey stays on a replayed run so the side effect is bounded.

journeys.name: two-step-consent-then-chosen-continuation
assertions: reaching a replayed decision request renders the options as side-by-side cards
selecting elevates the card, dims siblings and arms the CTA — a single click sends nothing
confirming sends the SELECTED option's id and the run's tool_call_id on the outbound request
the chosen continuation is observed and the selected card carries into the Cập nhật stage

journeys.name: decline-is-a-choice-not-an-error
assertions: the Không thực hiện control is reachable and never hidden behind the confirm
declining sends a decline and renders the declined outcome copy
the declined terminal state renders as a choice, never as an error state

journeys.name: expiry-and-rejection-render-honestly
assertions: an expired offer stops accepting input and says why, driven by the server-carried expiry
a rejected confirmation (fingerprint mismatch, already-decided, not-awaiting) renders the server's distinct condition, not a generic failure

staticAssetChecks.notes: Issue text: 'the new components must be in the built bundle.' Assert against the built artifact, not the source tree.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' Client components in apps/demo consuming an existing confirmation endpoint.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: 'the picker is additive; assert a run reaching a decision request without it degrades to a readable waiting state rather than a blank screen.' A rollback must not strand a paused run behind a blank canvas.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
any client-side computation of an expected-effect number — every rendered number and string must trace to a field in the event payload
a client-side expiry timer — the countdown reflects the server's own expiry, which is the only thing that cannot drift
a single-click path that authorizes a mutation; two-step consent is a security property here, not UX polish
rendering a declined run as an error or a failure exit
a generic failure message for a rejected confirmation — fingerprint mismatch, already-decided and not-awaiting are distinct server conditions and render distinctly
a retry-in-place control — ADR-084 decision 6 forbids it by name
